title: Spicy Yellow Paella with Beans
description: A flavorful and spicy paella dish made with yellow rice, beans, and indian spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the glazed yellow onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the indian spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the yellow rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the water, paella seasoning, and yummy tomato. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Add the cooked beans to the paella and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer, covered, for an additional 5 minutes.
